statement: Recorded AFTER run 2 crashed and was preserved as defect run 2, BEFORE the first scored run (run 3). Salts, streams, arms, r_grid, cost model, INCUMBENT_CAP, DOMAIN_CAP, predictions P1-P7 and the dual acquisition accounting are UNCHANGED from FNA4_FREEZE.json + FNA4_FREEZE_ADDENDUM_V1.json. Run 2's partial receipts are preserved verbatim at defect_runs/FNA4_DEFECT_RUN2_PARTIAL.json.gz (sha256 059b4b311cc177741c5ff0df9d5e289a528fb44578fb892a8a2598c226f4dabe) and are never edited.

defect_3.name: learn_au crashed on the full corpus (TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of 'NoneType' and 'str')
defect_3.evidence_in_run2: FNA4_DEFECT_RUN2_PARTIAL.json.gz: the AU arm's admission sort compared skeletons containing None holes (equal-length skeletons differing at a hole position). Run 1's corpus held 8 chains and never produced such a pair; the 1507-trace collect_all corpus does, immediately.
defect_3.attribution: learner stage (AU admission): the old implementation ranked skeletons with a plain tuple sort that assumed no None values.
defect_3.lever: incremental accumulator -- each pair observation updates obs[skeleton] and per-hole exhibited-value sets directly (no quadratic instance list), skeletons ranked by a None-safe _sk_sort_key; hole domains are the accumulated value sets, exactly what per-instance derivation would produce.

defect_3_perf.name: the rewritten learn_au constructed a Macro for every admitted candidate before the 6-cap discard
defect_3_perf.evidence: probe on billy-old (frozen corpus, read-only): the candidate materialisation path ran >12 CPU-min without completing (killed, no scored output); candidates with >=2 observations on the 1507-trace corpus are O(10^5), while MAX_LIBRARY=6 admits 6.
defect_3_perf.attribution: learner stage (AU admission): macro construction (warrant meet, sha256, domain materialisation) was executed per candidate instead of per admitted entry.
defect_3_perf.lever: signatures computed once per trace (not per pair); lazy admission materialising only the first MAX_LIBRARY skeletons in exactly _dedupe_macros order (-size, macro_id) -- the admitted SET is identical to materialise-then-cap; probe: learn_au 0.7 s, 1,134,777 charged units (1,134,771 pair comparisons + 6 admissions), 6 macros, byte-identical library across two runs.
defect_3_perf.charge_change_declared: AU learner steps = 1 per pair comparison (unchanged, frozen) + 1 per ADMITTED macro (6), instead of 1 per admitted CANDIDATE. No run ever scored the per-candidate charge; both the old and new charge are recorded here.

changes_vs_addendum_v1: fna4.py: make_macro gained an optional precomputed-domains argument (used by the incremental AU accumulator; default behaviour byte-identical for every other caller)
fna4_learners.py: learn_au rewritten per defect_3/defect_3_perf levers; _sk_sort_key added
fna4_solver.py, run_fna4.py, test_fna4.py: unchanged since addendum V1 digests
pre_score_probe_observation: On the frozen corpus the AU cap admits six 7-node recurring skeletons; the size-first _dedupe order ranks the longest recurring shapes above the 5-node F2 family shape. This is a parent property under the frozen shared cap, recorded before any scored run; it is measured, not tuned away.
unchanged_from_freeze: cost model (one commensurable unit per simulation/checker/posting/learner step)
dual acquisition accounting (full and marginal, as pinned in addendum V1)
